about: The fishing sounds: 48 kHz 16-bit mono WAVs, every file's peak at -1 dBFS. Play a sound at its "gain" (multiply) so the set is levelled against itself: swings under hits, hits under heavy hits, the finishing blow the loudest. Pick one of the files at random each time. loud_db: the loudest 50 ms of the file before the gain; target_db: where it should sit (the sword's hit = about 0).

fish_cast_v.use: the cast: a rod's whip and the line hissing out (the studio's, layered)
fish_cast_v.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -6 dB relative to it
